subject: ddl: fix affinity idempotency problem (#65291)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent. The change fixes a correctness/idempotency bug in `onAlterTableAffinity`: when `ALTER TABLE ... AFFINITY` sets the same affinity level, the old and new PD affinity group IDs are identical, so the previous create-then-delete sequence could remove the (existing or newly created) groups and leave metadata indicating affinity is enabled while PD has no groups. The new guard skips deletion when the affinity level is unchanged, while still deleting when affinity is removed or the level changes. Added PD-interaction regression tests for partition→partition and table→table idempotent ALTERs. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; subsequent changes touching the area are unrelated (region split policy) and do not revise this logic.
